summary: [[character:bill]] and [[character:garfield]] watch [[character:calvin]], [[character:goku]], and [[character:linus]] leave. Calvin and Goku depart together despite their continuing conflict, while Linus travels separately; Bill can only speculate about the reason. The first version-3 vessels, [[vessel:heaven-9]] and [[vessel:heaven-10]], are specially equipped for a destination Bill expects may hold other probes. [[organization:free-american-independent-theocratic-hegemony]] has avoided [[location:alpha-centauri]] because another superpower may have chosen it, and the group agrees to offer [[character:ernesto-medeiros|Medeiros]] neither warning nor quarter.

introducing.name: Heaven-9
introducing.description: A version-3 HEAVEN vessel equipped for a destination that may contain other probes. Oversized SURGE drives and reactors give it a maximum acceleration of 10 g. A smaller shielded reactor lets it coast through a system with its main reactor off, making it difficult to detect except at close range. It carries expanded ship-buster and scout complements, rail guns, and twin SUDDAR-jamming emitters intended to overwhelm nearby detectors with white noise.
introducing.current_state: Departing [[location:epsilon-eridani]] as part of the first version-3 cohort.

introducing.name: Alpha Centauri
introducing.description: A nearby stellar system considered an obvious first destination for an interstellar probe.

updates.description: A self-replicating spacecraft that travels between star systems building copies of itself, made possible for interstellar use by a subspace breakthrough and central to a competitive international colonization effort. Exponential replication could explore the galaxy, but practical self-construction is the main obstacle.
Tiny, single-purpose devices used for work below ROAMer scale; their flexibility is limited. Nanites alone cannot supply the energy needed to process high-grade materials for self-construction.

updates.current_state: In 2150, it avoids [[location:alpha-centauri]] because another superpower may already have selected it.
